body:
The reason of this issue is Animation doesn't sync with physics. 

The solution is change the AnimationPlayer's property "AnimationMixer -> Callback Mode -> Process'' from default "Idle" to "Physics". It tells “AnimationPlayer” running animation while "_process_physics" besides default "_process". Then the animation player does sync with physics.

By default, animation player runs on "_process()" not "_process_physics()", while the fps is 30, and ticks of physics is 60. The "_process_physics()" will run twice than "_process()". e.g. We put a CharacterBody2D on a AnimationBody2D.

By Default "idle"

- physics frame 1: animation doesn't run, position doesn't changed, platform_velocity is 0.
- physics frame 2: animation doesn't run, position doesn't changed, platform_velocity is 0.
- process 1: animation ran, position changed.
- physics frame 3: position changed against previous frame, platform_velocity not 0.
- physics frame 4: position doesn't changed, platform_velocity is 0.
- process 2: animation ran, position changed.
- physics frame 5: position changed against previous frame, platform_velocity not 0.
- physics frame 6: position doesn't changed, platform_velocity is 0.

After changed to "physics"

- physics frame 1: animation ran, position changed, platform_velocity not 0.
- physics frame 2: animation ran, position changed, platform_velocity not 0.
- physics frame 3: animation ran, position changed, platform_velocity not 0.
- physics frame 4: animation ran, position changed, platform_velocity not 0.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d61cd9149aaee6195b83bc65ca5539a27d76d61f/scene/animation/animation_mixer.cpp#L2349-L2359
